propositions: _lib_writes.py is at the 800-line hard cap enforced by CI, blocking the sibling create_ticket story which requires widening two @overload signatures and their docstrings

_lib_writes.py aggregates seven distinct concerns (genesis, identity+keys, status lifecycle, leaf mutations, session logs, store maintenance, signing) that grow independently on two axes: new verbs and argument widening

The module must be split by concern into _lib_mutations.py (concerns 4+5+6: leaf mutations, session logs, store maintenance ~280 LOC) and _lib_identity.py (concerns 2+7: identity and signing ~225 LOC), leaving _lib_writes.py with concerns 1+3 (genesis and status lifecycle ~375 LOC)

All 27 public names currently re-exported from _lib_writes must remain importable as rebar.<name> and rebar._lib_writes.<name> after the split, with moved names re-exported via noqa: F401 to keep __init__.py and _lib_gates.py unchanged
The split is behaviour-preserving with byte-identical body relocation and no logic rewrite, requiring no changes to test files or the public API surface
After the split, _lib_writes.py must reach ≤450 LOC, _lib_mutations.py must be 100-500 LOC, _lib_identity.py must be 100-500 LOC, and all existing tests must pass without modification
